name: Rainbow Omega Eastaboga
tagline: Where purpose Grows: Inside the Work and Heart of Rainbow Omega
description: Rainbow Omega Eastaboga is an independent berry farm in Eastaboga, AL. It grows Blueberries, with picking through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
